title: Reusable AppImage component with accessible fallback + refactor BrandLogo and CategoryGrid

requirements.summary: Add a reusable React/TypeScript AppImage wrapper around with consistent loading/decoding defaults, error handling, and an accessible Tailwind-styled fallback UI.
acceptanceCriteria: A new reusable image component exists (e.g., `frontend/src/components/AppImage.tsx`) that wraps an `` element.
The component supports: `src`, `alt`, `className`, optional `loading`/`decoding`, and an `onError` behavior that shows a fallback UI instead of a broken image icon.
Fallback UI is accessible (keeps meaningful alt/aria labeling) and visually reasonable with Tailwind styling.
The component does not rely on backend calls and uses only static asset paths (e.g., `/assets/generated/...`).

file_operations.description: Create `AppImage` React component that wraps an `` with typed props (`src`, `alt`, `className`, optional `loading`/`decoding`) and internal error state that swaps to an accessible, Tailwind-styled fallback container (using the provided alt text via `aria-label` or equivalent) to avoid broken-image icons and keep layout stable.

requirements.summary: Refactor BrandLogo and the service category cards grid to use AppImage while preserving existing sizing, hover/scale styling, and lazy-loading behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: `frontend/src/components/BrandLogo.tsx` uses the reusable image component and preserves its existing sizing API (`sm`/`md`/`lg`) and fallback behavior.
`frontend/src/components/CategoryGrid.tsx` uses the reusable image component and preserves existing hover/scale styling and lazy-loading behavior.
When an image fails to load, the UI does not show a broken image; it shows the defined fallback and the page layout remains stable.

file_operations.description: Replace the direct `` + local error state with `AppImage`, preserving the existing `size` API (`sm`/`md`/`lg`), existing sizing/object-fit classes, eager loading behavior, and the current branded fallback look (rounded block with bg/border) when the logo cannot be loaded.

Replace the category card `` with `AppImage`, preserving lazy loading/async decoding, the existing aspect-ratio container, and hover scale/transition classes; ensure failures render the AppImage fallback (not a hidden ``) so layout remains stable and no broken-image icon appears.
